content: Annotation In the development process it is often required to place annotation (a kind of yellow pads) to the model. In order to support this in a generic way, the abstract meta-class GeneralAnnotation is applied and specialized according to the particular use case. 146 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 If no further attributes are required, the concrete meta-class Annotation is applied.
